description_en: Queries the configurations of a specified honeypot template
description_zh: 获取指定的蜜罐模板配置
name: GetHoneypotPreset

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the honeypot template.

> You can call the [ListHoneypotPreset](~~ListHoneypotPreset~~) operation to query the IDs of honeypot templates.
